Guide notes & sources

An independently written, practical route for Final Fantasy VII (1997) and its original-game ports. Includes expanded directions throughout the main story, major optional quests, boss tactics, item inventories and event windows. It is not an exhaustive perfect-game or trophy guide.

Research checked November 2, 2026. Button mappings, names and trophy requirements differ by version. Disc labels describe the original story divisions, including digital releases. Future chapter names can be hidden in your journal; current chapter text and collection pages may contain gameplay spoilers.

Unofficial fan companion. Final Fantasy VII and its characters belong to Square Enix. No affiliation or endorsement. Guide prose and interface are original; linked walkthroughs remain with their authors.
